detail.objective: A record-scoped metadata-only presentation state: an artwork surface showing no image and no artist-associated procedural cover. RIGHTS-001 established the product has no blank state (js/app.js:2190 gates, 2204 falls through to canvasTag unconditionally), which makes options A3, B1, C3 and C4 unselectable and A1 unsafe. Scoped by Durer at 10 render sites, 4 pools, one prerender path and new CSS box states. Also in scope: image.status gates js/catalog-*.js only, while js/artworks.js holds 581 image entries and no status field at all (E-007).
